name: vscode-codex-ralphy
description: Runs a Ralph loop in VS Code by repeatedly invoking Codex with a workspace prompt.

ralphy.taskPath.description: Optional workspace-relative default task file used if a task picker is cancelled.

ralphy.codexCommand.description: Command used to start the Codex CLI.

ralphy.codexArgs.description: Arguments passed to the Codex command. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${promptPath}, and ${prompt}.

ralphy.sendPromptToStdin.description: Send the prompt file contents to Codex over stdin. The default arguments use `-` so Codex reads stdin.

ralphy.maxIterations.description: Maximum number of Codex iterations to run when starting the loop.

ralphy.stopWhenNoGapRemaining.description: Stop the loop when the iteration summary says the highest-value gap remaining is none.
